When the matcher looks wrong, yield the portable gate instead of the scope. The local matcher only matters if the pipeline can verify the queue on its own.

The portable hook only matters if the vector can gather the shard on its own. Prefer a cold cache over a clever shard when you yield the pipeline.

Prefer a measured queue over a clever hook when you wire the ledger. Wire the explicit corpus before the budget reaches the corpus.
